Matthew Arnold, Culture and Anarchy.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/matthew-arnold/culture-and-anarchy

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Matthew Arnold, the author, annotator, writer of the introduction and writer of the preface, died 1888.

First publication of the text used: 1869 (SE colophon: 'Culture and Anarchy was published in 1869 by Matthew Arnold.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1869, before 1931. A published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so it entered by 1964.
- Country of origin (every country): every person named above died in 1925 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less. The last to die did so in 1888.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."

Sources of these facts:
- SE colophon: publication in 1869.
